That code is very old. It does not follow the context and errgroup pattern

review_comments: Can we add a comment？ Before it was only used for adding columns，will it be used in both modifying column and the add index?
it has many usage but they all belong to write reorganization, so I rename it `newReorgSessCtx` to indicate reorg.
Do we need to cancel the ctx to notify we need stop `sendTasks`, after we remove`drainTasks`?
